title: Can you install a Bluetooth Collector in xDrip? So that you can connect xDrip+ so Master and Follower over Bluetooth directly without Internet, does it go?
body:
Hello developer,

is it technically possible to make a Bluetooth Collector from the xDrip app? So the two parsed bluetooth phones could send the xDrip values over Master / Follower? Would be interesting for 640 G Uploader mobile phone because there is a measuring device there. So that you can use the main mobile phone freely and get the values of Bluetooth Master, is something technically intergresible? Thanks already for your efforts and a possible answer.

Best regards

Matthias
